stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dr. Christina Raynor is Bucky Barnes' government-mandated therapist after his pardon. She pushes him to make amends and open up to people, and she does not buy his claim that he just wants peace.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Dum Dum Dugan are among the prisoners Steve Rogers frees from HYDRA, and both join his Howling Commandos. They fight together across Europe until Bucky's fall.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Everett Ross takes custody of Bucky Barnes after his capture in Bucharest and has him held in Berlin. When Zemo triggers Bucky's programming, he breaks loose from Ross' facility.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Bucky Barnes runs into Georges Batroc when the mercenary turns up fighting for the Flag Smashers. Bucky battles him alongside Sam Wilson, and Batroc covers the Flag Smashers' escape with a cloud of smoke.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Ghost is one of Valentina's disposable agents who joins Bucky Barnes' makeshift team after the vault. She fights alongside him to save New York from the Void.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Helmut Zemo uses HYDRA's trigger words to unleash the Winter Soldier and frame Bucky Barnes for the Vienna bombing.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Bucky Barnes breaks Zemo out of prison to help hunt the Flag Smashers, and the two team up uneasily.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Howard Stark are on the same side in the war against HYDRA.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: In 1991 the brainwashed Winter Soldier kills Howard Stark and steals the super soldier serum he was carrying.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: As the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes fought Isaiah in Korea in 1951. Decades later Bucky brings Sam Wilson to meet him, and Isaiah is still bitter about how he was treated.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jack Rollins works alongside the Winter Soldier on HYDRA's hunt for Steve Rogers in Washington. He guards Bucky while his damaged arm is repaired and warns Pierce that the asset has become unpredictable.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: James Rhodes sides with Tony Stark over the Sokovia Accords. He corners Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers at the end of the Bucharest chase and fights Bucky at the Leipzig airport.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: James Rhodes and Bucky Barnes fight side by side in Wakanda against Thanos' army.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: As the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes pulls Jasper Sitwell out of a moving car and kills him.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Jim Morita are freed from the same HYDRA prison camp and join Steve Rogers' Howling Commandos. They fight together across Europe until Bucky's fall.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Joaquin Torres works alongside Bucky Barnes as they help Sam hunt the Flag Smashers, flying with them into Germany.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: John Walker takes up the Captain America shield, and Bucky Barnes refuses to accept him in the role. When Walker kills a man in public, Bucky and Sam fight him and take the shield back.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Bucky Barnes works with John Walker and the rest of Valentina's outcasts to stop Valentina de Fontaine.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Sam Wilson hunt Karli Morgenthau and her Flag Smashers across Europe. In their first clash she kicks Bucky off a moving truck with super soldier strength, and he later helps stop her final attack on the GRC in New York.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Lemar Hoskins teams up uneasily with Bucky Barnes and Sam Wilson while they all chase the Flag Smashers.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: On HYDRA's orders, the Winter Soldier kills Maria Stark right after killing her husband Howard on a December night in 1991.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Mel is Valentina de Fontaine's assistant, and Bucky Barnes tries to turn her against her boss. She refuses to testify, but she quietly tips him off to track Valentina's phone.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: The Winter Soldier shot Natasha Romanoff years ago while killing her target, and he comes after her again when HYDRA rises in Washington.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff and Bucky Barnes end up on the same side in Wakanda, fighting off Thanos' army.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Under HYDRA's orders the Winter Soldier ambushes Nick Fury in Washington and shoots him through a wall, leaving him for dead.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Okoye and Bucky Barnes fight side by side in Wakanda when Thanos' army attacks.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Peter Parker and Bucky Barnes are on opposite sides of the Sokovia Accords split. Peter takes him on for Tony Stark at the Leipzig airport, catching his metal fist and marveling at the arm.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Peter Parker and Bucky Barnes fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson fights the Winter Soldier in Washington while helping Steve Rogers bring down HYDRA.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Sam Wilson sides with Steve Rogers to protect Bucky Barnes after the Vienna bombing. The two bicker constantly while they fight together against Tony Stark's side.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes start out bickering, but they become a real team and true friends while hunting the Flag Smashers.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sarah Wilson welcomes Bucky Barnes when he comes to Louisiana, and he helps her and Sam fix up the family boat.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Bucky Barnes poses as the Winter Soldier to meet Selby in Madripoor and ask about the serum.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Sharon Carter helps Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers by smuggling them their gear in Germany.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sharon Carter shelters Bucky, Sam and Zemo in Madripoor and helps them track the serum. All the while she is secretly running the city as the Power Broker.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Shuri helps clear the Winter Soldier programming from Bucky Barnes' mind in Wakanda, and the two become friends.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers are best friends from their childhood in Brooklyn. Bucky fights at Steve's side with the Howling Commandos until he falls from Zola's train.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: HYDRA has turned Bucky into the Winter Soldier, and he no longer knows Steve when they clash in Washington. Steve refuses to fight him on the helicarrier, and Bucky pulls him out of the river.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Steve Rogers stands by Bucky Barnes after he is framed for the Vienna bombing, protecting him even against Tony Stark.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: T'Challa hunts Bucky Barnes, believing he killed his father, until he learns Zemo framed him. He then gives Bucky refuge in Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Freed of HYDRA's programming in Wakanda, Bucky Barnes fights for T'Challa when Thanos' army attacks.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross wants Bucky Barnes captured after the bombing in Vienna.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes is freed from a HYDRA prison camp along with the men who become the Howling Commandos, and he fights at their side under Steve Rogers. He is with them until he falls from Zola's train.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Tony Stark learns that the brainwashed Winter Soldier murdered his parents, and he tries to kill Bucky Barnes in Siberia, blasting off his metal arm.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Tony Stark and Bucky Barnes fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Bucky Barnes, now a congressman, tries to bring down Valentina Allegra de Fontaine over her secret Sentry project. He teams up with her disposable agents to stop her, but she spins it by branding them the New Avengers.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vasily Karpov is the HYDRA officer who keeps the Winter Soldier's trigger words, and in 1991 he sends Bucky Barnes to kill Howard and Maria Stark. Years later Zemo tracks Karpov down to take those words.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision tries to stop Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers from escaping at the Leipzig airport, using the Mind Stone to block their path.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Bucky Barnes helps defend Wakanda while Shuri works to remove the Mind Stone from Vision.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Bucky Barnes, now a congressman, rescues Yelena Belova and her fellow outcasts after they escape Valentina's vault, and he pushes them to take Valentina down. Yelena ends up leading the team, which Valentina rebrands as the New Avengers.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Yori Nakajima is Bucky Barnes' neighbor and lunch companion in Brooklyn. He does not know that Bucky killed his son as the Winter Soldier, until Bucky finally confesses.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: John McIver, called Bushmaster, comes to Harlem for revenge on Mariah Dillard and beats Luke in a fight. Later the two make a temporary alliance against her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Bushmaster wants revenge on the Stokes family and tries to kill Mariah Dillard.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty investigates Bushmaster during his war on Mariah Dillard and questions him about the attempt on Mariah's life. He greets her as Babylon's finest and boasts that he needs no gun or prosthetic arm to have power.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Inspector Priscilla Ridley leads the police against Bushmaster.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: When Shades goes to the Yardies for the money Mariah Dillard needs, he finds Bushmaster in charge, a man set on destroying her. Shades spends the war that follows trying to keep Mariah alive against him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Tilda Johnson treats Bushmaster with her herbs. They start as enemies and become allies.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Jason Wilkes is a scientist working for Calvin Chadwick's company, Isodyne Energy.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Peggy Carter investigates Calvin Chadwick after learning he was rumored to be the lover of a murdered woman. Chadwick charms her at the races, then agrees to Whitney Frost's plan to have her killed.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Rufus Hunt is the Arena Club's head of security and works for Calvin Chadwick and the Council. Whitney Frost pushes Chadwick into letting Hunt kill Peggy Carter, and when Hunt later tries to blackmail Chadwick, Whitney absorbs him with Zero Matter.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Calvin Chadwick and Vernon Masters are friends and fellow members of the Council of Nine.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Whitney Frost is Calvin Chadwick's wife and the real brains behind his career. She kills him with Zero Matter.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo is Daisy Johnson's father. He spends years trying to get his daughter back, and in the end he kills her mother Jiaying to save her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo teams up with Daniel Whitehall to get close to the man who hurt his wife, planning to kill him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Gordon has little patience for Calvin Zabo, telling him he is no Inhuman, just a science experiment. He warps Cal away before he can kill Coulson, and later captures him to end his war on S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo threatens Jemma and the team, and she fends him off with an I.C.E.R. when he transforms. When his heart stops, she revives him with adrenaline, which accidentally completes the formula in his blood.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo is Jiaying's husband. When she turns murderous, he kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo forces his way into helping Fitz and Coulson save Trip's life, threatening to kill Trip if Coulson shoots him. Later, powered up by his own formula, he smashes out of the medical pod and comes after Fitz and the others.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Melinda May faces off with Calvin Zabo as he hunts for his daughter Skye and tries to win her over. When Jiaying hands him over as a peace offering, Skye delivers her father into May's custody.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo blames Phil Coulson for keeping his daughter Daisy from him and tries to kill him. In the end he helps Coulson stop Jiaying, and Coulson gives him a fresh start with his memories wiped.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Raina knew Calvin Zabo since she was a girl. She brings him news of his daughter and works with him for a time.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Camilla Reyes, an old friend of Coulson's, first fights beside May's team in Peru, then has her squad knock May out with gas so they can seize the Bus and the 0-8-4. May and the team break free and take the plane back.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Camilla Reyes is a Peruvian officer and Phil Coulson's former love interest. She betrays him to steal an alien artifact.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Candace Miller waits tables at Cottonmouth's club, Harlem's Paradise, and is too scared to bring him drinks alone. After his death, Mariah Dillard uses her to frame Luke Cage for the murder.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Candace Miller is one of the hostages Diamondback's men take at Harlem's Paradise, and Diamondback threatens her life. He knows she is the witness Mariah Dillard bribed and wants her dealt with.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Candace Miller works at Harlem's Paradise alongside Luke. She is murdered for agreeing to testify against Diamondback and the Stokes family.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After Cottonmouth's murder, Mariah Dillard orders Candace to tell the police that Luke Cage did it and pays her off for the lie. When Candace's guilt drives her to Misty Knight, Mariah has her killed.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty persuades Candace Miller to testify, and after that Candace is murdered.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shades drives Mariah to pay Candace off for her false statement. When Candace decides to tell Misty the truth, Shades lures her out with Misty's stolen phone and kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Skye helps Melinda May take down Carl Creel, the Absorbing Man, by hitting him with a taser rifle.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Graviton absorbs Creel, and Creel dies when Daisy blasts Graviton out into space.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall takes Carl Creel on as his brainwashed assassin and has him steal the Obelisk back from the military. Creel obeys every order, though he cares nothing for HYDRA's goals.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Under Daniel Whitehall's orders, Carl Creel ambushes Glenn Talbot to learn where the Obelisk is kept.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Free of HYDRA's control and sorry for what he did, Creel wins Glenn Talbot's trust and becomes his personal bodyguard. He helps rescue Talbot from Malick's men.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Both end up in General Hale's program, and once Talbot is twisted by the Gravitonium, he turns on Creel and absorbs him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: General R. Hale recruits Carl Creel after the Superior's attempt on his life, convincing him that S.H.I.E.L.D. is the enemy and making him a pawn of HYDRA once more. She tells him she is putting together a team, not hiring a gun.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Carl Creel attacks Isabelle Hartley's team during a deal, and in the fight she grabs the Obelisk with her bare hand. She survives losing the hand, but Creel then causes the car crash that kills her.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Jack Murdock faces Carl "Crusher" Creel in the ring in his final fight.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Jemma Simmons studies Carl Creel after S.H.I.E.L.D. captures him, questioning him in a containment module and testing his blood to learn how he could touch the Diviner and survive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: S.H.I.E.L.D. sends John Garrett to terminate Carl Creel, but Garrett, secretly HYDRA, fakes his death and recruits him as an assassin instead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Carl Creel attacks Isabelle Hartley's team and nearly kills Lance Hunter, then causes the crash that kills Hartley. Hunter becomes obsessed with revenge and even knocks out his own teammates to go after Creel.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Fitz turns his old Overkill Device designs into a weapon that overloads Carl Creel's absorption powers so Coulson can stop him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lincoln Campbell ambushes Carl Creel in a parking lot, thinking he is stalking Coulson and Glenn Talbot, and his electric powers prove too much for Creel. He nearly kills Creel before Coulson orders him to stop.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: May clashes with Carl Creel, the Absorbing Man, after he kills Isabelle Hartley's team over the Obelisk. She saves Glenn Talbot from him by kicking Creel away, and Skye stuns him so Talbot's soldiers can take him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Phil Coulson stops the Absorbing Man, Carl Creel, by stabbing him with a device that disrupts his powers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Free of HYDRA's control, Creel joins Coulson's mission as Glenn Talbot's bodyguard and saves Coulson and Talbot from Malick's men.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Working for General Hale, Creel listens when Coulson warns him she is using him, and he helps Coulson break Talbot out.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Raina approaches Carl Creel about the Obelisk he is chasing for HYDRA, offering him a carbyne ring that would protect him from its touch. Creel turns her down, telling her whatever she is offering isn't enough.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Carl Creel and Ruby Hale both work in General Hale's program, and Ruby eventually tries to kill him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi is HYDRA's handler for Carl Creel, passing on Whitehall's orders and rewards. He sends Creel to kill Roger Browning and to go after the Obelisk.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Christian Blake and Carl Hoffman are partners and best friends on the force. Fisk forces Hoffman to kill Blake.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Foggy Nelson and Matt represent the corrupt detective Carl Hoffman when he agrees to testify against Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley handles Detective Carl Hoffman as one of Fisk's corrupt cops.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Carl Hoffman goes on the run after killing his partner. Matt Murdock catches him, then serves as his lawyer when he testifies against Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Detective Carl Hoffman is a corrupt cop who works for Fisk. He later testifies against Fisk and helps bring down his empire.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dar-Benn blames Carol for the civil war that ruins Hala after she destroys the Supreme Intelligence. Armed with a Quantum Band, she drains other worlds to restore Hala until Carol, Monica and Kamala stop her.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Carol rescues G'iah, Talos's young daughter, along with the other Skrull refugees.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Decades after Carol saved her, G'iah gains a share of Carol's powers through the Harvest.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Goose is Wendy Lawson's cat, who takes an unusual liking to Carol. After Lawson's death, Goose travels with Carol and Nick Fury into space.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Goose now lives with Carol aboard her ship, passed on to her by Maria Rambeau. When the S.A.B.E.R. station is in danger, Goose and her newborn kittens help get the crew out.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Kamala is Carol's biggest fan and dreams of being like her. When their powers become entangled, they team up with Monica Rambeau as the Marvels to stop Dar-Benn, and Carol guides her as a hero.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Korath serves with Carol on Starforce while she is known as Vers. When she turns against the Kree, he is among the soldiers she defeats on Earth.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Mar-Vell, posing as Dr. Wendy Lawson, mentors Carol Danvers as a test pilot. Carol gains her powers when Mar-Vell's engine explodes.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Maria Rambeau is Carol Danvers's best friend from their days as Air Force pilots, and she helps raise Monica with her. When Carol returns without her memory, Maria helps her remember.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva is Carol Danvers's Starforce teammate and rival. She resents Carol and later tries to kill her.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Carol Danvers is Monica Rambeau's godmother and like an aunt to her.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: As an adult, Monica is hurt that Carol never came back. Fighting side by side as the Marvels brings them close again.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol Danvers meets Muneeba Khan when Kamala's powers bring Carol into their home. Carol later asks Muneeba's help to keep Kamala safe.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Natasha fills Carol in on the Snap when she arrives at the Avengers Compound. For the next five years, Carol is part of the Avengers team Natasha runs, checking in from across the galaxy.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol finds Nebula and Tony stranded aboard the Benatar and carries the ship back to Earth. Nebula then serves alongside Carol in the Avengers through the five years after the Snap.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Carol Danvers meets Nick Fury in 1995, and they become friends. She leaves him a pager to call her in an emergency.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol and Okoye both serve in Natasha's Avengers after the Snap, checking in by hologram. In the Battle of Earth, Okoye helps hold off the horde as Carol carries the Nano Gauntlet toward the Quantum Tunnel.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: In the Battle of Earth, Peter Parker introduces himself and hands Carol the Nano Gauntlet, and she flies it toward the Quantum Tunnel through Thanos's army.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Phil Coulson is a rookie S.H.I.E.L.D. agent when Carol Danvers crash lands on Earth in 1995. When the agency moves to capture her and Fury, Coulson quietly lets them get away.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Prince Yan of Aladna is Carol Danvers' husband through a political marriage.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rocket pilots the Benatar with Carol as co-pilot when the Avengers go after Thanos on the Garden. In the years after, both serve in Natasha's Avengers, and Rocket openly complains about Carol during their check-ins.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Ronan works with Starforce while Carol serves the Kree as Vers. When he brings his fleet to bomb Earth, Carol destroys his warheads and forces him to retreat.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Carol finds Soren hiding with the other Skrull refugees and assures her she means them no harm, apologizing for her part in the war. She then helps reunite Soren with Talos and get their people to safety.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol Danvers answers Nick Fury's pager and meets Steve Rogers and the surviving Avengers at their compound. She joins Steve's strike on Thanos at his garden planet and fights beside him in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: The Supreme Intelligence controls Carol Danvers through her implant until she breaks free of it.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol has since gone back to Hala and destroyed the Supreme Intelligence, and the Kree blame her for the civil war that follows.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Talos first hunts Carol and digs through her memories for the location of the Light-Speed Engine. He then shows her that the Kree have lied to her and the Skrulls are refugees, and she helps his people escape the Kree to find a new home.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol Danvers destroys Thanos's warship and fights him in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol Danvers finds Tony Stark and Nebula drifting in deep space after Thanos' victory and carries their ship back to Earth. She then fights alongside Tony in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol Danvers and Valkyrie become good friends after the war with Thanos. When a Kree attack leaves the Skrulls without a home, Carol calls Valkyrie for help sheltering them.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Yon-Rogg takes Carol from Earth, gives her his blood and erases her memories, then trains her as the Kree soldier Vers. When she learns the truth, she turns on him, beats him, and sends him back to Hala.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol Danvers drops into the Khan home when her powers tangle with Kamala's, startling Yusuf on his couch. When the Kree attack the house, she catches a staff about to be driven into Yusuf and throws his attacker through the roof.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Carson Wolf is sent to hunt down David Lieberman and tries to kill him.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Carson Wolf is Dinah's superior at Homeland Security. Secretly he works against her investigation.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Carson Wolf is a Homeland Security agent who tortures Frank for information about Micro. Frank kills him.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Carson Wolf is Sam Stein's boss at Homeland Security, and his dislike for Stein leaves him stuck at a desk in a hallway. After Wolf's murder, Stein writes up his autopsy and uncovers thirty million dollars hidden in his offshore accounts.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: William Rawlins brings Carson Wolf into his illegal operations and sends him after David Lieberman.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Casey files the evidence Hunter B-15 brings in, including the Tesseract she seizes from Loki.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter B-15 relies on Casey to track down Renslayer and brings him to the Temporal Loom, where his know-how helps Ouroboros.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Casey is the TVA clerk who processes Loki on arrival and shows him a drawer of Infinity Stones used as paperweights.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Casey helps Loki and the others in their fight to save the TVA.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Casey is starstruck when he realizes Ouroboros wrote the TVA Guidebook, and the two become partners at the Temporal Loom. Together they track Dox's reset charges and race to scale up the Loom before it fails.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Victor Timely works alongside Casey and the TVA team to repair the Loom.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Cassandra Nova rules the Void, and Logan and Deadpool first team with her and then fight her. In the end she dies in the Time Ripper.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Mr. Paradox brings Cassandra Nova out of the Void, hoping to use her. She turns on him and nearly kills him.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Darren Cross takes Cassie Lang hostage as Yellowjacket.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Darren Cross, now M.O.D.O.K. and serving Kang, hunts Cassie in the Quantum Realm. When she tells him he can still change, he turns on Kang and helps her.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Cassie builds a satellite with Hank Pym's help to send signals into the Quantum Realm. The signal is hijacked and pulls the whole family into the Realm.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Jentorra captures Cassie Lang when she arrives in the Quantum Realm. Cassie later rallies the people of Axia to Jentorra's revolt.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Jim Paxton is Cassie's stepfather, raising her like his own daughter alongside her mother Maggie.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Kang captures Cassie in the Quantum Realm and threatens her life to force Scott to steal the Multiversal Engine Core for him. Cassie then helps lead the Realm's people in the uprising against Kang.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Maggie is Cassie's mother. She raises Cassie with Jim Paxton and urges Scott to keep his promise to stay out of crime for their daughter's sake.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Quaz questions Cassie and Scott when they turn up at the freedom fighters' camp, reading their minds to confirm they are not spies for Kang.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Cassie Lang is Scott Lang's daughter and the reason he tries to go straight.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Now a teenager, Cassie becomes a hero alongside her father and suits up to fight beside him in the Quantum Realm.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Chafa, the first Choctaw, is a distant ancestor of Chula Battiest. When Chula struggles through Taloa's birth, a vision of Chafa and their other ancestors gives her the strength to survive.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Lowak is a descendant of Chafa, the first Choctaw. Around 1200 A.D., when the Choctaw face banishment over a tribal ball game, a vision of Chafa gives Lowak the strength to fight her way out of the pile and score the winning goal.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Chafa is one of Maya's Choctaw ancestors, whose story she sees in visions.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Taloa Lopez is a descendant of Chafa, part of the line of women whose ancestors echo through them in times of need. After her death, Taloa appears to her daughter Maya to explain how those generations echo through her.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Tuklo is a descendant of Chafa. When her father refuses to let her join the Lighthorsemen, visions of Chafa and Lowak give her the strength to find the men who captured them and kill them all.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: When Chan Ho Yin, the pyrokinetic who calls himself Scorch, turns on Coulson's team after Centipede twists his powers, Coulson has May sneak up and overdose him with Extremis. The dose makes him overheat and explode.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson's team rescues Chan Ho Yin, then has to stop him when he turns violent.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina recruits Chan Ho Yin into Centipede, which turns him into Scorch.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: James Wesley handles Detective Christian Blake as one of Fisk's corrupt cops.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Christian Blake is one of Wilson Fisk's corrupt detectives. When he and Carl Hoffman hold Karen Page, Matt Murdock and Foggy Nelson confront them and get her released on bail.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Detective Christian Blake is a corrupt cop on Fisk's payroll. When Blake becomes a liability, Fisk forces his partner Carl Hoffman to kill him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Senator Christian Ward backs Glenn Talbot's campaign to hunt down the remaining S.H.I.E.L.D. agents after the HYDRA uprising, because he wants Phil Coulson arrested.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Grant Ward's older brother Christian abused him as a child. Grant later kills Christian and their parents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Senator Christian Ward backs Glenn Talbot's campaign against S.H.I.E.L.D. and wants Phil Coulson arrested. Coulson confronts him with the news that his brother Grant is in S.H.I.E.L.D. custody and offers to hand Grant over in exchange for Christian's public support against HYDRA.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Reporter Christine Everhart accompanies Justin Hammer to the Monaco Grand Prix to interview him for Vanity Fair. She loses interest the moment Tony Stark mentions that Hammer's military contract was revoked.

stages.title: WHIH Newsfront (Part 1)
stages.text: Christine Everhart interviews Scott Lang for WHiH a day before his release from San Quentin. Scott complains she is unfair to him because VistaCorp, the company he robbed, owns WHiH, and the interview ends with him getting tased.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Christine Everhart is a reporter who keeps pressing Tony Stark about his company's weapons dealing, from their first interview in Las Vegas to the Gulmira photos she confronts him with at a benefit. They spend one night together after that first interview.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Christine Palmer is Stephen Strange's ex-girlfriend and a fellow surgeon. She saves his life more than once as he finds his way into the mystic arts.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Christine marries another man, and Stephen attends her wedding as a friend.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Christine Palmer operates on the Ancient One at Metro-General Hospital after Kaecilius mortally wounds her, working with Strange to keep her alive. The Ancient One dies despite their efforts.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Christofi Savva, first mate of the Northern Star, joins the resistance and tells Karen what he knows about Fisk's cargo.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie takes the deposition of Christofi Savva, who testifies that Kingpin ordered the Northern Star sunk.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Christofi Savva is first mate of the Northern Star when Daredevil storms the ship and its captain scuttles it. Savva survives, and after Daredevil frees the woman who sheltered him, he agrees to testify against Fisk, only to be killed by Buck Cashman.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Christofi Savva works on the Northern Star for an employer he is sure is Wilson Fisk.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Lowak is one of Chula Battiest's ancestors, a Choctaw woman from centuries earlier. Her echo is among the visions that give Chula strength while she gives birth to Taloa.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Chula Battiest is Maya's grandmother. Maya has been estranged from her since her mother's death, and they reconcile in Tamaha.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Chula Battiest and Skully were once a couple, sitting together by the fire with Taloa and William. Skully is beside her the night she learns Taloa has been killed, and though they later split up, he stays close to the family.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Chula Battiest is Taloa's mother, who gave birth to her with strength from her ancestors and learned sign language to raise her deaf daughter. Taloa's death in a car accident breaks Chula's heart and drives her to cast William out of the family.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Tuklo is one of Chula Battiest's ancestors, a woman who became a hero by rescuing the Lighthorsemen. She appears to Chula braiding her hair during Taloa's difficult birth, helping her survive the labor.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Claire Temple trains in martial arts under Colleen Wing at the Chikara Dojo, and the two become close friends. Claire stands by Colleen through the fight against the Hand and comforts her after Bakuto's betrayal.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Claire Temple becomes Danny Rand's friend and patches him up through his war with the Hand.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Claire Temple works uneasily with Davos, Danny Rand's friend from K'un-Lun, against the Hand.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Diamondback shoots Luke Cage with a Judas bullet while Luke walks with Claire, then tracks them down to the clinic where she is trying to dig it out. When he grabs her through the window, Claire stabs him in the arm.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Claire Temple befriends Jessica Jones and treats her wounds during her fight with Kilgrave.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Claire patches Jessica up again when Jessica joins Matt, Luke and Danny against the Hand.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Claire Temple and Luke Cage fall for each other while she nurses him through his worst injuries.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Claire and Luke are together, but his growing anger frightens her, and their relationship ends.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Claire Temple is the nurse who first finds Matt bleeding in a dumpster, and she keeps patching him up as Daredevil. They share a brief romance, but what lasts is their friendship.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Claire Temple and Misty Knight first clash over Luke Cage, with Claire insisting he could not have killed Cottonmouth because he was with her. When Misty is shot during the siege of Harlem's Paradise, Claire stitches up her wound.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Claire and Misty grow close during the fight against the Hand. When Bakuto holds his swords to Claire's neck, Misty charges in to save her and loses her arm.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Claire Temple patches up the corrupt detective Rafael Scarfe after he is shot, while helping Luke Cage get him to safety.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Vladimir Ranskahov's Russian mob kidnaps and tortures Claire Temple to find Daredevil.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Clark Pitts, known as Cherry, is Foggy Nelson's friend from his years as a detective. Foggy is shot dead by Bullseye at Cherry's retirement party.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Clark Pitts, known as Cherry, befriends Karen Page during his years as a detective. Later they fight side by side in the resistance against Wilson Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie is a friend of Clark Pitts, known as Cherry, and he works the Hector Ayala case with her at Murdock & McDuffie.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Clark Pitts, known as Cherry, is Matt Murdock's friend from the NYPD and keeps his secret identity. After retiring, he becomes Matt's private investigator and joins his resistance against Wilson Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Matt Murdock hires Clark Pitts, known as Cherry, to dig into Wilson Fisk's campaign finances. Cherry goes on to fight Fisk's regime with the resistance.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Classic Loki lives in Kid Loki's underground bunker in the Void. He accepts Kid Loki as king of the Void and survives alongside him.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Classic Loki is an older variant of Loki who faked his death to escape Thanos. He takes Loki in when Loki is pruned to the Void and dies helping him and Sylvie face Alioth.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Classic Loki hides out with Kid Loki's band in the Void, where President Loki leads a rival gang of variants. When President Loki's army corners the band at its bunker, the Lokis turn on one another.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Classic Loki meets Sylvie, another variant of himself, in the Void. He sacrifices himself so that she and Loki can enchant Alioth.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Clea confronts Stephen Strange in New York and tells him his meddling with the multiverse caused an Incursion. She recruits him to help her fix it.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Cooper is the eldest son of Clint and Laura Barton, raised in secret on the family farm.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Clint loses Cooper to the Snap and is reunited with him five years later.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Helen Cho saves Clint's life after a battle against Hydra, rebuilding his damaged skin with her Regeneration Cradle at Avengers Tower.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Clint Barton helps Natasha Romanoff in her attempt to kill Dreykov in Budapest.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Eleanor Bishop warns Clint Barton to keep her daughter Kate out of his mission, reminding him that Natasha Romanoff was good too and still died. Behind his back she has Valentina Allegra de Fontaine send Yelena Belova after him so he cannot get in the way of her dealings with Wilson Fisk.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Grills is a firefighter who takes the Ronin suit home from a fire and wears it to LARP. Clint wins it back by joining the game, and Grills becomes his friend.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Clint Barton first suspects Jack Duquesne of working with the Tracksuit Mafia. In the end they fight on the same side at Rockefeller Center.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell and Clint are fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agents. When Loki takes over Clint's mind and he sabotages the Helicarrier with a hacking arrow, Sitwell works to regain control of the ship.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Kate has idolized Clint since she watched him fight in the Battle of New York as a child. When she puts on his old Ronin suit, he reluctantly takes her on as his partner and protégé over one Christmas, and comes to see her as his successor as Hawkeye.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Kazi tries to kill Clint Barton during the fight at Rockefeller Center.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Laura Barton is Clint Barton's wife, who keeps their family safe on the farm while he is away.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Lila is Clint Barton's daughter, raised in secret on the family farm.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Clint teaches Lila archery on the farm, and she vanishes in the Snap moments after he praises her bullseye. They are reunited after the Blip.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki takes control of Clint Barton's mind with his scepter and uses him to attack S.H.I.E.L.D. Once freed, Clint wants payback and fires an exploding arrow at Loki during the Battle of New York.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Lucky tags along with Clint Barton and Kate through their Christmas fight in New York and goes home with them to the Barton farm.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill is a senior S.H.I.E.L.D. officer over agents like Clint. When Loki takes over Clint's mind, the two trade gunfire as he escapes the Joint Dark Energy Mission Facility.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Maya Lopez blames Ronin for her father's death and hunts Clint Barton. When he tells her Fisk ordered the hit, she turns on Fisk.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff and Clint Barton are best friends. He was sent to kill her years ago but recruited her into S.H.I.E.L.D. instead.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: On Vormir, Natasha and Clint fight over which of them will be the sacrifice for the Soul Stone, and she gives her life so he can live.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Nathaniel is the youngest child of Clint and Laura Barton. He is born after the fight against Ultron and named after Natasha Romanoff and Pietro Maximoff.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Nebula fits Clint into his Time Suit for the first test run and joins the time heist with him. During the Battle of Earth, she kills her past self to save Clint and the past Gamora.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Clint Barton is one of Nick Fury's top S.H.I.E.L.D. agents and is guarding the Tesseract when Loki takes his mind. Fury is one of the few who know about Clint's secret family and helped him keep them hidden.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Clint Barton and Phil Coulson are longtime S.H.I.E.L.D. colleagues. In New Mexico, Coulson has Clint take aim at Thor during the break in at Mjolnir's crater.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki takes over Clint's mind, and Clint is still under Loki's control when Loki kills Coulson.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro taunts and outruns Clint while the twins fight against the Avengers. After switching sides, Pietro dies in Sokovia shielding Clint and a child from gunfire, and Clint later names his son after him.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: As Vormir's Stonekeeper, the Red Skull tells Clint Barton and Natasha Romanoff the price of the Soul Stone.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Clint and Sam both side with Steve Rogers against the Sokovia Accords and are locked up together in the Raft afterward.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Clint recruits Scott to Steve Rogers' side over the Sokovia Accords. At the airport battle, Scott rides one of Clint's arrows to sneak inside Tony Stark's armor, and both end up locked in the Raft.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Clint Barton fights alongside Steve Rogers as one of the original Avengers.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Clint comes out of retirement to stand with Steve against the Sokovia Accords and is locked up on the Raft for it until Steve breaks him out.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Clint fights T'Challa hand to hand at the airport battle over the Sokovia Accords.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: In the Battle of Earth, Clint hands the Nano Gauntlet to T'Challa to keep it away from Thanos.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Clint and Natasha's bombing of Dreykov's office in Budapest leaves young Antonia Dreykov badly hurt. Her father then turns her into the Taskmaster.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross imprisons Clint Barton in the Raft for breaking the Sokovia Accords.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Clint Barton keeps Thor in his sights during the break in at Mjolnir's crater, ready to shoot if Coulson gives the word.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Clint Barton and Thor fight together as founding Avengers.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Clint Barton fights beside Tony Stark as one of the original Avengers.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Clint and Tony end up on opposite sides over the Sokovia Accords, and Clint lands on the Raft.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Clint and Tony reunite for the Time Heist to undo the Snap.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron fights Clint Barton and the Avengers in Sokovia, and Pietro Maximoff dies shielding Clint from Ultron's gunfire.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Clint and Vision fight side by side as Avengers against Ultron.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: When Clint comes to break Wanda out of the Avengers Compound, he traps Vision with an electrified arrow and they clash.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda tries to take over Clint's mind when she first fights the Avengers, but in Sokovia he talks her into fighting as one of them.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Clint comes out of retirement to break Wanda out of the Avengers Compound so she can join Steve Rogers' side.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: As Ronin, Clint was secretly used by Wilson Fisk, who fed him tips so he would kill the Tracksuit Mafia's leaders. When Clint returns to New York, he and Kate Bishop break up Fisk's Tracksuit operation.

stages.title: Black Widow (Post-Credits Scene)
stages.text: Valentina tells Yelena that Clint Barton is to blame for Natasha's death.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Yelena hunts Clint down in New York and nearly kills him, until he convinces her of how Natasha really died and she lets him go.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cole North and Connor Powell are friends on the force who both idolize the Punisher, and they serve together on Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cole North idolizes the Punisher and wears his skull while hunting vigilantes for Fisk. Frank Castle despises cops like him, and he and Daredevil take North's men down in the raid on Matt Murdock's apartment.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cole North is the gunman who kills Hector Ayala, the White Tiger, after his acquittal.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Cole North of the Anti-Vigilante Task Force guards Jack Duquesne in custody. The task force later tries to kill Duquesne.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Cole North escorts Kirsten McDuffie into the Freeport complex, where she argues with him over denying Jack Duquesne a lawyer.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cole North is the NYPD sergeant behind White Tiger's death, and Wilson Fisk recruits him to hunt vigilantes. He leads the raid on Matt Murdock's apartment, where Daredevil and the Punisher take him and his men down.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Sergeant Cole North leads work for Mayor Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force. Fisk tells him to take the credit for stopping Muse.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Colleen Wing becomes Danny Rand's girlfriend and fighting partner.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Danny comes to believe the Iron Fist belongs with Colleen and passes its power to her.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Davos, Danny Rand's friend from K'un-Lun, fights the Hand alongside Danny and Colleen Wing.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos steals the Iron Fist from Danny, and Colleen fights him with Danny and Misty.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Elektra fights Colleen Wing and the Defenders as the Hand's Black Sky.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Colleen Wing fights alongside Jessica and the other Defenders against the Hand.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Colleen returns Joy's package of M&M's with only the brown ones missing, proving to Joy that the stranger really is Danny.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Joy sides with Davos against Danny and Colleen, storming out of the dinner where Danny tries to make peace.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Colleen Wing sets up the meeting where Luke Cage and Danny Rand settle their first fight and agree to work together. She then fights beside Luke against the Hand as an ally of the Defenders.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Colleen joins Danny's mission to rescue Radovan Bernivig from Madame Gao and travels with him to Anzhou to confront her. Gao leads a faction of the same Hand that Colleen served through Bakuto, and capturing her brings Colleen's divided loyalties to a head.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Danny brings Mary home to Colleen's apartment when she seems lost and dehydrated, and Colleen teases him that Mary has a crush on him. Mary is secretly photographing them for Joy and Davos, and Colleen soon suspects she is watching them.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Colleen Wing fights alongside Matt and the other Defenders against the Hand.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Misty and Colleen Wing become close friends while fighting the Hand.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty and Colleen team up as partners in fighting crime.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward Meachum works with Colleen and Danny against the Hand.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Ward works with Colleen and Danny again once Davos turns against them.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Colonel Phillips runs Project Rebirth with Dr. Erskine but pushes him to pick the strong Gilmore Hodge, while Erskine insists on scrawny Steve Rogers. Phillips's dummy grenade settles the argument when Steve throws himself on it.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Colonel Chester Phillips recruits Howard Stark into the Strategic Scientific Reserve after showing him what HYDRA's weapons can do. Howard works with Phillips through Project Rebirth and the fight against Red Skull.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Colonel Chester Phillips commands the SSR, and Peggy Carter serves under him through the war. She rescues Dr. Erskine from HYDRA while Phillips flies overhead, and they run Project Rebirth together.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Colonel Chester Phillips runs Project Rebirth and doubts the scrawny Steve Rogers until Steve throws himself on a dummy grenade. After Steve rescues the captured men of the 107th, Phillips puts him in charge of his own unit to fight HYDRA.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Colonel Phillips commands the Strategic Scientific Reserve, and the Howling Commandos carry out his missions against Hydra once Captain America puts the team together.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Cottonmouth's men try to kill Connie by blowing up her restaurant while they are after Luke.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Connie Lin is Luke's landlady and runs Genghis Connie's restaurant. Luke saves her when Cottonmouth's men attack, and she stays his friend.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Connor Powell idolizes the Punisher and has his skull tattooed on his body. When the Anti-Vigilante Task Force captures Frank Castle, Powell offers him a place among them, and Frank refuses.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Phil Gallo calls Connor Powell one of the most problematic officers in the department. He confronts Powell's task force at the Black & White Ball.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Connor Powell is present when his partner Kel Shanahan dies in a fight with Hector Ayala. Powell lies about what happened at Hector's trial.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Connor Powell is one of the Anti-Vigilante Task Force officers who try to kill Jack Duquesne.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie faces Connor Powell in court during Hector Ayala's trial.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Connor Powell is the NYPD officer who arrests Hector Ayala, which puts him at odds with Matt Murdock as Hector's lawyer. He later joins Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force and tries to kill Daredevil.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Officer Connor Powell serves on Mayor Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force and reports to him directly.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Laura is Cooper's mother. She raises him on the family farm that she and Clint keep secret from the world.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Cooper and Lila are the two older Barton children, raised together on the family farm.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Natasha is a close friend of the Barton family and an aunt figure to Cooper. He is happy to see her when she arrives at the farm with the Avengers.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Cooper and Nathaniel are brothers. Cooper plays catch with his little brother at the family picnic and praises his throwing.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Corvus Glaive and Cull Obsidian are adopted brothers in Thanos' Black Order. In Wakanda they team up to beat down Vision until Bruce Banner, in the Hulkbuster armor, drags Cull away.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw and Corvus Glaive are adopted brothers raised by Thanos in the Black Order. After the massacre on the Statesman, Thanos sends Maw to New York for the Time Stone and Corvus to Edinburgh for the Mind Stone.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Corvus Glaive and Gamora are both adopted children of Thanos, raised in his service alongside the rest of the Black Order.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: In Edinburgh, Natasha ambushes Corvus Glaive as he attacks Wanda and Vision and stabs him with Proxima Midnight's spear. They face each other again in the Battle of Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Corvus Glaive and Nebula are both adopted children of Thanos, though Nebula despises him and the rest of the Black Order.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Proxima Midnight is married to Corvus Glaive, who is also her adoptive brother in the Black Order.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: In Edinburgh, Sam Wilson fires missiles at Corvus Glaive to pull him off Vision, giving Natasha Romanoff the opening to wound him. Corvus and Proxima Midnight are forced to retreat.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Corvus Glaive storms Shuri's lab while she is removing the Mind Stone from Vision, forcing her to abort the procedure and knocking her down to the level below.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Steve Rogers rescues Wanda and Vision from Corvus Glaive and Proxima Midnight in Edinburgh. They clash again when Thanos' army attacks Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Corvus Glaive is Thanos' adopted son, an orphan raised to fight in the Black Order. He stands by as Thanos kills Heimdall with Corvus' own blade, then hunts Vision and the Mind Stone for his father in Edinburgh and Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Corvus Glaive stabs Vision in Edinburgh and later tries to take the Mind Stone in Wakanda. Vision kills him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Corvus Glaive ambushes Wanda Maximoff and Vision in Edinburgh, stabbing Vision as he is about to answer her. He and Proxima Midnight nearly kill them both before Steve Rogers' team arrives.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Kraglin and Cosmo watch over Knowhere together while the Guardians go to save Rocket. They bicker, and he hurts her feelings by calling her a "bad dog," but at Christmas she gives him an Orloni she hunted as a present.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: When Cosmo strains to hold two ships together so the rescued children can cross to Knowhere, Mantis uses her powers to give her more strength.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Cosmo joins the Guardians at their base on Knowhere. Quill leaves her and Kraglin to guard Knowhere, and she later links the two ships so Quill can bring the rescued children home.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Rocket and Cosmo snarl at each other when they first cross paths in the Collector's museum. Later they rebuild Knowhere together, and Cosmo stays on in the new Guardians team Rocket leads.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: The Collector finds Cosmo drifting in space and keeps her on display in his museum on Knowhere. After the museum is wrecked, she tries to comfort him by licking his face.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: When the High Evolutionary's forces attack Knowhere, Cosmo helps fend them off and uses her powers to keep his ship from crashing into it.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Diamondback is Cottonmouth's old friend and his gun supplier, and he even gave him the Biggie Smalls poster that hangs in his office. After Cottonmouth dies, Diamondback moves in on his criminal empire.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Domingo Colon is an old friend turned rival of Cottonmouth's in Harlem's drug trade.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Cornell Stokes, called Cottonmouth, is Luke's former employer at Harlem's Paradise. He becomes Luke's first big enemy after his men kill Pop.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Cornell Stokes and Mariah Dillard are cousins who run the family's business together. She kills him in a fit of rage.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty investigates Cottonmouth and the Stokes crime family throughout her work in Harlem. In the end she arrests him at Harlem's Paradise for the murder of her partner Rafael Scarfe.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Pop knew Cornell Stokes since Cornell was young, and he keeps a fragile peace with him as a customer. In the end Cottonmouth's men kill Pop.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Detective Rafael Scarfe is a dirty cop on Cottonmouth's payroll. Cottonmouth shoots him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shades brings Diamondback's guns to Cottonmouth and works alongside him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Cottonmouth is related to Tilda Johnson through the Stokes family, as both her uncle and her cousin.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Tone is Cottonmouth's bodyguard. Cottonmouth kills him for shooting up Pop's Barber Shop.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett tips off Cottonmouth's people about the man who robbed Cottonmouth, hoping to collect the reward.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Zip is one of Cottonmouth's enforcers, a thug with bigger ambitions than his job. After Cottonmouth's murder, Zip switches sides to Diamondback.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian are adopted brothers, both raised by Thanos to fight in the Black Order. On the Statesman Maw holds Cull back from helping Thanos against the Hulk, and the two then go to New York together to take the Time Stone.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Cull Obsidian and Gamora are both adopted children of Thanos, though Gamora wants nothing to do with him or the rest of the Black Order.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Cull Obsidian and Nebula are both adopted children of Thanos, though Nebula despises him and the rest of the Black Order.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Spider-Man joins the fight against Cull Obsidian in Greenwich Village, catching a hammer blow meant for Tony Stark before being thrown across the park.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Cull Obsidian and Proxima Midnight are adopted siblings in Thanos' Black Order. Together they lead the attack on Wakanda, demanding the Mind Stone and unleashing the Outriders when T'Challa refuses.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: During the Battle of Earth, Scott helps Spider-Man by crushing Cull Obsidian under his giant foot.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Cull Obsidian comes after the Time Stone around Doctor Strange's neck when the Black Order lands in Greenwich Village. Strange fights him off alongside Tony Stark and Wong before Ebony Maw carries Strange away.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Cull Obsidian is one of the orphans Thanos takes from a conquered world and raises as a child in the Black Order. He fights at his father's side on the Statesman and leads his assault in New York and Wakanda in the hunt for the Infinity Stones.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Cull Obsidian attacks Tony Stark, Stephen Strange and Wong in New York when Thanos' Children come for the Time Stone. Wong ends the fight by sending him through a portal.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: During the Battle of Wakanda, Cull Obsidian joins Corvus Glaive in attacking Vision in the forest, battering him with his hammer to get at the Mind Stone.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Wong fights Cull Obsidian when the Black Order invades Greenwich Village. He gets rid of him by dropping him through a portal and snapping it shut on his arm.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Curtis Hoyle and Micro start out suspicious of each other. They end up working together to help Frank.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Dinah Madani seeks out Curtis Hoyle, Frank's friend, for answers about Billy Russo's past, since Russo has shot them both. The two then work together to protect Amy Bendix from John Pilgrim while Frank hunts Russo.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Curtis Hoyle is Frank's fellow veteran and closest friend. He runs a support group and gives Frank medical help and advice.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: John Pilgrim hunts Amy Bendix, and Curtis Hoyle works to keep her out of his reach. When Pilgrim tracks Frank Castle to a trailer, he finds Curtis there instead, and the two men size each other up.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Curtis Hoyle counsels Lewis Wilson through his PTSD in his support group for veterans and talks with him one on one. Lewis misreads Curtis's advice and slides into extremism, becoming the bomber terrorizing New York.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: D.W. Griffith is a young fan of Luke's who sells his videos and cheers him on. He also helps out Bobby Fish.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Daniel Sousa joins the team after they save him from his own death in 1955. He and Daisy Johnson fall for each other while fighting the Chronicoms across time.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall wants Daisy Johnson, then known as Skye, brought to him, since decades earlier he cut open her mother, Jiaying, to steal her youth. Coulson kills him when the team storms his base to get Skye back.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Micro is one of Skye's hacker contacts from the Rising Tide. He sends her photos of a murder victim carved with strange alien symbols, which puts Coulson's team on the killer's trail.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Agent Davis works alongside Daisy on S.H.I.E.L.D. missions, such as tracking down L.T. Koenig and the Darkhold.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Davis joins Daisy on the long search through space for Leo Fitz.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Deke Shaw has an obvious crush on Daisy Johnson from the day they meet in the future. She never returns it, but they end up good friends and teammates.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Skye first meets Donnie Gill as a troubled S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy cadet and comforts him after his only friend dies.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Once HYDRA brainwashes Donnie, he tries to freeze a ship full of people, and Skye stops him with a sniper shot that sends him into the sea.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Elena Rodriguez and Daisy Johnson are friends and fellow Inhumans. Daisy recruits Elena for the Secret Warriors.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Enoch, a Chronicom, becomes a loyal friend to Daisy and the team on their trips through space and time.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Enoch sacrifices himself to free Daisy and Phil Coulson from a time loop, saying it has been a privilege to be part of their family.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Eric Koenig welcomes Skye and Coulson's team to Providence, one of Nick Fury's secret bases, and questions each of them before handing out lanyards. Soon after, Skye finds his body hidden in a closet and realizes Grant Ward killed him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Felix Blake is a senior S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who watches Skye become a Level 1 agent.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Felix Blake resurfaces with the anti-Inhuman Watchdogs, and Daisy tracks him down.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Daisy gets to know Gabe Reyes while working with his brother Robbie, the Ghost Rider, and stops a group of thugs from stealing his wheelchair. Later she flies Gabe out to Zephyr One so he can see Robbie.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick tries to have Daisy Johnson killed. Under Hive's control, she kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: A robot copy of Daisy Johnson shoots Glenn Talbot in the head.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: As Graviton, Talbot fights Daisy, and she kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Gordon, the eyeless teleporter from Afterlife, finds Daisy Johnson after her change and brings her to Jiaying's haven. He stays loyal to Jiaying when she goes to war with S.H.I.E.L.D., which puts him on the opposite side from Daisy.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Grant Ward is Skye's first supervising officer, and the two grow close while he trains her in the field.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: When Ward is exposed as HYDRA, Skye turns on him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: When Ward delivers Skye to her father, she shoots him four times.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: General Hale blames Daisy for shooting Glenn Talbot, orders S.H.I.E.L.D. arrested, and secretly leads Hydra. She even plans to turn Quake into a weapon with Gravitonium, but when her daughter Ruby spins out of control, Hale surrenders to Daisy and helps her storm the Hydra base.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy Johnson and Lincoln Campbell go to James, a loner from Afterlife, for help finding a Kree relic. Later, as Hellfire, he serves Hive alongside the Daisy that Hive controls.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: James comes to hate all Inhumans and blames Daisy for what he suffered, and he betrays her to the Watchdogs.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hive takes control of Daisy Johnson's mind. When she breaks free, she joins the fight to destroy him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: While under Hive's control, Daisy helps kidnap Holden Radcliffe so he can build Hive's army of Inhumans.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Radcliffe works with his android Aida to trap Daisy's friends inside the Framework, and she goes in to get them out.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Ian Quinn shoots Daisy Johnson on John Garrett's orders and nearly kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: In the Kree temple, the Terrigen Mist turns Quinn to stone, and he shatters when Skye's new powers erupt.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Isabelle Hartley's mercenary team works with Skye after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, and Skye backs her up on the job to recover the Obelisk. When Hartley is killed after Carl Creel attacks her team, Coulson asks Skye to pack up her belongings.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Jeffrey Mace becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. while Daisy is a fugitive vigilante and orders her brought in. Once she returns, they learn to trust each other: she saves him from the Watchdogs, and he helps clear her name.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Jemma Simmons and Daisy Johnson are best friends. They have been through nearly everything together since Daisy joined Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jiaying is Daisy Johnson's mother and the leader of the Inhuman haven Afterlife. She welcomes Daisy at first, then tries to drain Daisy's life force to heal herself.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy rescues Joey Gutierrez from the ATCU when his power to melt metal first emerges, and S.H.I.E.L.D. helps him learn to control it. He joins her Secret Warriors and answers when she calls him to help rescue S.H.I.E.L.D. agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett, the Clairvoyant, orders Ian Quinn to shoot Skye, leaving her near death. After Garrett is exposed as Hydra, Skye helps turn Deathlok against him, and Deathlok kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Kara Palamas, brainwashed by Hydra as Agent 33, fights Skye in Vancouver and gets the better of her until Lance Hunter steps in. Skye urges her to stand down and accept S.H.I.E.L.D.'s help, but Kara refuses.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Kasius tries to sell Daisy Johnson to buyers and makes her fight for him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lance Hunter joins Coulson's team after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls and becomes a good friend to Skye, trading stories about his ex-wife and her old crush on Grant Ward. Early on, he knocks her out with an I.C.E.R. so he can go after Carl Creel himself.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Fitz and Skye become close friends on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: When Skye gains her powers, Fitz is the first to help her hide them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Daisy spends a year searching space to bring Fitz home.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lincoln Campbell guides Daisy Johnson through her change into an Inhuman at Afterlife, and the two grow close.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy and Lincoln fall in love, and he gives his life to save her and the world from Hive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Maria Hill helps Coulson's team escape Glenn Talbot's soldiers. She then chases Grant Ward down in a jump jet when he tries to deliver Skye to John Garrett.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Melinda May is Daisy Johnson's supervising officer and trains her to fight. Over the years they become close friends who trust each other with their lives.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: After HYDRA turns Mike Peterson into the cyborg Deathlok, Daisy Johnson helps Coulson's team free him. He later fights beside her as one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most loyal allies.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Nick Fury runs S.H.I.E.L.D. when Skye joins Phil Coulson's team, and he warns Coulson that the former Rising Tide hacker is a risk. After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Fury turns up to help the team bring down John Garrett.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson recruits Daisy Johnson into S.H.I.E.L.D. and becomes a father figure to her. She grows from a hacker on his plane into one of his most trusted agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Piper is a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who shoots Daisy with an I.C.E.R. while Hive has her under his control.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Piper has become a trusted friend, and she joins Daisy on the year-long search through space for Leo Fitz.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina, the Centipede scientist in the flower dress, is obsessed with Skye's true nature and believes their destinies are linked.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Both go through Terrigenesis in the Kree city, and at the Inhumans' Retreat Raina's visions expose Jiaying's plans to Skye just before Jiaying kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Daisy Johnson hunts for the Ghost Rider as a vigilante, and Robbie Reyes first treats her as an enemy. They become friends and allies against his uncle Eli Morrow.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Robert Gonzales leads the rival S.H.I.E.L.D. that sees Skye's new powers as a threat and sends Bobbi Morse to bring her in. He later comes to the Inhumans' Retreat to make peace, where Skye's mother Jiaying kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy looks out for Robin Hinton, the young seer whose father died helping S.H.I.E.L.D., and gives her a carved robin he made for her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: When HYDRA captures Phil Coulson, Daisy takes Robin out of hiding to help find him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Rosalind Price runs the ATCU, the task force that locks up new Inhumans, and Daisy distrusts her even after Coulson forms an alliance with her. When Rosalind falls during an attack, Daisy catches her with her powers and saves her life.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale is raised to see Quake as the rival she must beat to earn her mother's approval. She hunts Daisy down and attacks her with her chakram blade.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sif comes to Earth to stop the Kree warrior Vin-Tak, who wants to kill Skye after her powers emerge, and Sif decides Skye should be taken to Asgard. She relents only after seeing Skye risk herself to protect her friends.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Sinara, Kasius' Kree enforcer at the future Lighthouse, helps capture Daisy so she can be sold to the highest bidder. The two fight more than once, and Daisy finally kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: The Doctor insists on cutting Daisy Johnson's power inhibitor out of her, whatever the pain.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Anton Ivanov, the Superior, leads the Watchdogs in killing Inhumans, and Quake fights him and his men head on. She cripples him in battle, though he keeps coming back through his robot duplicates.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Tucker Shockley is an Inhuman who hates his own kind and works with the Watchdogs. He attacks Quake with his taser rod while stealing the Darkhold, and she takes him down more than once.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Victoria Hand takes command of the Bus during the search for the kidnapped Phil Coulson and sends Skye off the plane after she hacks without permission. Skye pushes back, insisting that finding Coulson matters more than protocol.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Vin-Tak, a Kree warrior, comes to Earth to wipe out the power of the Inhumans and sees Skye as a weapon that must be destroyed. He hunts her through the Playground until Sif and Coulson's team stop him.

stages.title: Eternals
