stages.text: Dane Whitman is Sersi's boyfriend and a fellow museum worker in London. He asks her to move in with him just before Arishem takes her away.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sprite is Dane Whitman's friend through Sersi, and she teases them both about their romance.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Daniel Blake is Mayor Fisk's aide, who helps Fisk paint Daredevil as a terrorist.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Daniel Blake talks his way onto Fisk's mayoral campaign through Sheila Rivera, the campaign manager, who takes him on because he will work cheap. They go on to work side by side in Fisk's office, and Rivera has her doubts when Fisk promotes Blake to deputy mayor for communications.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Daniel Blake is a young admirer who joins Fisk's campaign and rises on his staff. Fisk forgives him once for a leak.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Fisk's people murder Blake, and the truth about his death helps turn the city against Fisk.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Daniel Drumm once trains alongside Kaecilius at Kamar-Taj. After Kaecilius betrays the Masters of the Mystic Arts, he storms the New York Sanctum and kills Drumm, its protector.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dottie Underwood is a Leviathan assassin who fights Daniel Sousa in an office stairwell and escapes him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Sousa and Peggy Carter capture Dottie and force her to help them against Whitney Frost, but she gets away again.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa first meets Edwin Jarvis as a suspect while the S.S.R. hunts Howard Stark, and Jarvis secretly gives Sousa a tip in a fake American accent.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Sousa and Jarvis become allies, working with Peggy Carter against Whitney Frost.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa hunts Howard Stark for the SSR, which believes Howard sold his weapons to enemies overseas.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Howard has since been cleared, and in Los Angeles he helps Daniel's team fight Whitney Frost and her Zero Matter.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa and Jack Thompson are fellow S.S.R. agents who often clash. Driven mad by the Midnight Oil gas, Sousa tries to kill Thompson, but the two later team up with Peggy Carter to stop Johann Fennhoff.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Sousa and Thompson team up with Peggy Carter again to stop Whitney Frost.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: When Jemma poses as Peggy Carter at the S.S.R. in 1955, Daniel Sousa sees through the act and arrests her. After the team saves him from the death history had planned for him, he joins them aboard Zephyr One.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa unknowingly interrupts Johann Fennhoff, posing as Dr. Ivchenko, while he is hypnotizing Chief Dooley. At Stark's warehouse Sousa corners Fennhoff at gunpoint, and Fennhoff tries to talk his way into Sousa's mind.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Daniel Sousa and Peggy Carter fight their way past Joseph Manfredi's guards and pressure the mob boss into helping them against Whitney Frost, his former lover. Manfredi ends up working with them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: When Daniel Sousa joins the team after they save him in 1955, May shakes his hand and her new empathy picks up how overwhelmed he is. Realizing he means to run, she flies a Quinjet after him, and the team saves him from being killed.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa and Peggy Carter work together at the SSR, and he quietly falls for her.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Peggy and Daniel finally admit their feelings for each other and share a kiss.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: By the time Sousa joins Coulson's team, he and Peggy have long since broken up and gone their separate ways.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Ray Krzeminski mocks Daniel Sousa's war injury and laughs off Sousa's demand that he apologize to Peggy Carter. Still, the two work the night shift together and follow the tip that leads them to Stark's stolen inventions.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Roger Dooley is chief of the S.S.R.'s New York office, where Daniel Sousa works under him chasing leads on Howard Stark. Sousa brings Dooley evidence like Stark's car at the Roxxon refinery, and Dooley puts him on the night shift that turns up Stark's stolen inventions.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Rose Roberts follows Daniel Sousa from New York to run the front desk of his new S.S.R. office in Los Angeles. She is his friend and confidante, teasing him about not telling Peggy Carter that he is dating Violet.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: After Peggy Carter kidnaps Rufus Hunt, she and Daniel Sousa interrogate him in secret. Hunt refuses to give up any names and mocks Daniel's missing leg.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vernon Masters walks into Daniel Sousa's SSR office with a team of FBI agents and orders him to call off his raid on the Arena Club. When Masters later turns on Whitney Frost, he has to make a deal with Sousa, Peggy and Jack Thompson.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Daniel Sousa, now running the SSR in Los Angeles, investigates Whitney Frost alongside Peggy Carter. Working together to stop her brings Daniel and Peggy closer.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick and Daniel Whitehall both rise to lead HYDRA. When they meet in 1970, Malick tells him about the ancient ritual of stones that sends an unlucky member to the planet where Hive waits.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Grant Ward goes to work for Daniel Whitehall after escaping S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall trains R. Hale as one of his HYDRA students and chooses her for his plan to bring a future leader of HYDRA into the world. Long after his death, Hale raises her daughter Ruby for that purpose.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jemma Simmons goes undercover inside Hydra and works her way up into Daniel Whitehall's own lab, spying on him for S.H.I.E.L.D. When her cover is blown, she escapes his organization with Bobbi Morse's help.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall cut Jiaying open to steal her youth and left her for dead. Her husband Calvin Zabo saved her and swore revenge.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall captures Agent 33, Kara Palamas, and brainwashes her into serving HYDRA, even though she swears she never will. She remains his agent until his death.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Peggy Carter captures Werner Reinhardt in 1945 and sends him to prison.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall leads HYDRA against Phil Coulson's rebuilt S.H.I.E.L.D. and races him for the Kree city and its Obelisk. When Coulson's team storms Whitehall's base, Coulson shoots him dead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Raina works for Daniel Whitehall's HYDRA out of fear, since even she is terrified of him. He threatens her into delivering Skye, and his help lets her track down the Diviner and the Kree city.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall, born Werner Reinhardt, rises as a HYDRA officer under Johann Schmidt during the war. For decades afterward he carries on the Red Skull's work.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale was born from Daniel Whitehall's Hydra program and was raised to see him as her creator.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi is Daniel Whitehall's fiercely loyal second in command, proud to serve a man he calls a disciple of Red Skull. He carries out Whitehall's campaign to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. and recover the Obelisk.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Dorothy Walker adopted Danielle's mother, Jessica Jones, which makes her Danielle's adoptive grandmother.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: James Lucas is Luke Cage's father, which makes him Danielle's grandfather.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Jessica is Danielle's mother. She raises her daughter in a quiet home and fights off the armed CIA agents who come for them there.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Luke is Danielle's father. He returns to her and Jessica once his CIA work is done.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles is the CIA handler who keeps Danielle's father overseas. His agents also attack her home.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Danielle is the daughter of Jessica Jones and Luke Cage, which makes Jessica's adoptive sister Trish her aunt.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Davos grows up with Danny in K'un-Lun as his adoptive brother and best friend, and he comes to New York looking for him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Bitter that Danny became the Iron Fist, Davos steals the power and turns on him.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Elektra kidnaps Danny Rand so the Hand can use the Iron Fist to open their door beneath Midland Circle.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Danny Rand fights Madame Gao's champions one after another and defeats them.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Harold Meachum was Wendell Rand's partner and arranged the plane crash that killed Danny's parents. He later tries to kill Danny, and Danny comes close to killing him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Jeri is Danny Rand's lawyer and friend, and she helps him prove who he is.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Danny Rand is a fellow Defender. He and Jessica first clash, then fight the Hand together.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Joy Meachum was Danny's childhood best friend.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Joy turns on Danny and works with Davos against him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Lei Kung trains Danny in K'un-Lun and raises him as an adoptive father. He prepares Danny to become the Iron Fist.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Danny Rand and Luke clash when they first meet, then become close friends and fellow Defenders.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Danny comes to Harlem to help Luke in his war with Bushmaster.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Madame Gao kidnaps and tests Danny Rand, the Iron Fist. He fights her and the Hand.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Mary Walker befriends Danny in her gentle Mary persona while her violent Walker side works for Joy and Davos to capture him. She helps Davos steal the Iron Fist, then later turns on Davos and tries to kill him.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Danny Rand is the Iron Fist. Matt fights beside him in the Defenders and protects him from the Hand.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Misty becomes friends with Danny Rand while they fight the Hand together.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty fights beside Danny and Colleen Wing against Davos.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Murakami joins the other Hand leaders in hunting the Iron Fist, and Danny fights him personally when the Hand ambushes the Defenders at a Chinatown restaurant.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: After Luke captures Sowande, the Defenders interrogate him, and he mocks Danny as the dumbest Iron Fist he has ever met. When he tries to escape, he holds a knife to Danny's throat and reveals that the Hand needs the Iron Fist, before Stick kills him.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Stick joins the Defenders against the Hand and helps keep Danny tied up so the Hand cannot take him. When he learns the Hand needs the Iron Fist, he decides to kill Danny himself, but Elektra kills Stick before he can.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward Meachum bullied Danny as a child, and he fights him for control of Rand Enterprises.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Ward and Danny become true friends and brothers in arms.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Danny is Wendell Rand's son. Wendell dies in the plane crash that leaves Danny stranded in the Himalayas.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Zhou Cheng is the Hand's warrior who guards Madame Gao, and Danny defeats him in a drunken duel.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dar-Benn wants Kamala Khan's bangle to complete her pair. She attacks Kamala's family home in Jersey City to take it.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dar-Benn's jump-point attacks keep tangling Monica Rambeau's powers with Carol and Kamala's. Monica helps bring her down.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dar-Benn attacks Aladna, Prince Yan's home world, to steal its air and water, and tries to kill him.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dar-Benn once served the Supreme Intelligence. She becomes the Kree's leader after Carol Danvers destroys it.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Darcy Lewis and Erik Selvig work together on Jane Foster's research team in New Mexico.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: In London, Darcy helps look after Selvig after Loki's mind control leaves him unsteady.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Darcy Lewis takes on Ian Boothby as her unpaid intern in London, and he helps her plant Erik Selvig's gravimetric spikes before the Convergence. The two kiss after the battle in Greenwich.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Darcy Lewis is Jane Foster's intern and becomes one of her closest friends.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Darcy Lewis and Jimmy Woo meet outside Westview and become fast friends while studying Wanda Maximoff's broadcast together.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Darcy Lewis and Monica Rambeau team up outside the Westview Hex to figure out what Wanda Maximoff is doing. Darcy backs Monica when S.W.O.R.D.'s director turns on them.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Darcy Lewis mocks Director Tyler Hayward's reckless handling of Westview and digs through his private files, uncovering his plan to bring Vision's body back online. Hayward has her thrown off the base, and she later stops his escape by ramming his car with a truck.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: When Wanda Maximoff expands her Hex, Darcy Lewis is swept inside and made into an escape artist in Wanda's sitcom. Even so, Darcy comes to sympathize with Wanda.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Darius, known as Comanche, was in Seagate Prison with Luke Cage and later fights him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades and Darius, known as Comanche, are best friends from prison who were once lovers. When Shades learns Comanche is a police informant, he kills him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Captain Tom Ridenhour recruits Comanche, an ex-con close to Shades and Mariah Dillard, as his mole inside the Stokes crime family. When Shades catches them at a secret meeting, the panicked Comanche shoots Ridenhour dead.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Darren Cross is Hank Pym's former protégé, who pushes Hank out of his own company. Obsessed with recreating the Pym Particles, Cross builds the Yellowjacket suit to sell to Hydra, and Hank recruits Scott to stop him.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Hope van Dyne works beside Darren Cross at Pym Technologies while secretly spying on him for her father, and she helps Scott Lang bring him down.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Darren Cross, as M.O.D.O.K., hunts Janet van Dyne in the Quantum Realm.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: When Yellowjacket attacks Paxton's home to get at Cassie, Paxton tries to shoot him but is quickly disarmed.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Kang turns Darren Cross into M.O.D.O.K. and makes him his servant in the Quantum Realm. Cross turns on Kang, and it costs him his life.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Darren Cross tries to sell his Yellowjacket suit to Mitchell Carson, who secretly works for HYDRA.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Scott Lang fights Darren Cross as Ant-Man.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Cross returns as M.O.D.O.K. in the Quantum Realm, hunting Scott for Kang, but he finally turns on Kang to help him.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: During the heist at Pym Technologies, Dave steals Jim Paxton's police car to keep him from stopping Hank Pym. Paxton later recognizes their van's horn and arrests Dave and Kurt.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Dave and Kurt are friends on Luis's crew, and they help Scott break into Hank Pym's house.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Dave and Luis are partners on the crew that recruits Scott for the heist at Hank Pym's house.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Dave is Scott's getaway driver on Luis's crew. He helps Scott break into Hank Pym's house.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Sonny Burch's men tie Dave up at the X-Con office while they interrogate Luis. Dave returns the favor at Pier 39, tasering Burch's men so the police can arrest them.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: David leaks evidence to Dinah Madani about the corruption he uncovered.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: David Lieberman, known as Micro, first tracks Frank down as a stranger. Then the two become partners against Agent Orange and real friends.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Gunner Henderson is the soldier who sends Micro the footage of Ahmad Zubair's execution, then goes into hiding in Kentucky. When Frank tracks him down, Micro helps the two of them fight off the Anvil team sent to kill Gunner.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: David is Sarah's husband. He fakes his death to protect her and their children, and then he watches over them in secret.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: William Rawlins finds out David Lieberman leaked the truth about Cerberus and hunts him down.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Agent Davis checks Yo-Yo in for her Inhuman checkups and jokes with her about his pregnant wife.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: After the war with the Chronicoms, Davis is brought back as a Life Model Decoy, and he, Yo-Yo and Piper go on missions together as a team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Agent Davis gets fed up with Enoch's constant complaining as they flee through space, but lets it go when Piper reminds him what Enoch did for them. When Atarah orders Davis and the others killed, Enoch turns on her to save them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Agent Davis escapes the Playground with Jemma Simmons and Daisy before it is blown up, and he helps Jemma hunt for Aida.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Davis joins Jemma on the long search through space for Fitz.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Agent Davis is one of the agents who pull Fitz out of the chamber where he has trapped Aida.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Davis joins Daisy and Jemma on the long search through space to bring Fitz home.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Agent Davis flies alongside May on several missions, and the two of them turn Zephyr One upright and pilot it into space to rescue Coulson and Glenn Talbot.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: The alien Izel possesses Davis and jumps from him into May's body.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: After Aida's attack on the Playground, Deathlok finds Agent Davis wounded and carries him to safety.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Agent Davis flies and fights alongside Phil Coulson, from tracking Jeffrey Mace's suit to Alaska to piloting the Quinjet when Coulson goes to confront Glenn Talbot in Chicago.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Piper and Agent Davis are partners and best friends who serve on mission after mission together.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Piper and Davis join the long search through space for Fitz. When Izel kills Davis, Piper joins the mission to stop her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: After the war with the Chronicoms, Piper has Davis brought back as a Life Model Decoy, and they go on missions together again with Yo-Yo.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Joy, betrayed by her father and brother, teams up with Davos to take the Iron Fist from Danny. Once Davos has the power and grows violent, she regrets the partnership and hires Mary Walker to protect her from him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Lei Kung is Davos's father, a monk of K'un-Lun who trains him mercilessly to become the Iron Fist. When Lei Kung takes in Danny Rand and the Iron Fist goes to Danny instead, Davos's jealousy takes root.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos works with Mary Walker in his plan against Danny, but she turns on him and tries to kill him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty helps Danny and Colleen take Davos down, first sneaking his unconscious body back to the dojo instead of arresting him. Once Davos is finally caught, she lets Danny say a last goodbye before taking him to jail.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos steals the Iron Fist, and Ward fights him alongside Danny and Colleen.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Death Dealer and Razor Fist are Xu Wenwu's top lieutenants and lead the Ten Rings into Ta Lo together. When the Soul Eaters break loose, Death Dealer is killed at once, and Razor Fist ends up fighting alongside the villagers.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Death Dealer trains Shang-Chi relentlessly for seven years in the Ten Rings compound, teaching him every way to kill a man. Years later he hunts his former pupil in Macau, and they duel until Wenwu steps in.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Death Dealer is a loyal Ten Rings warrior whom Xu Wenwu brings in to train his son Shang-Chi as a boy. He follows Wenwu into the attack on Ta Lo, where a Soul Eater kills him.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Death Dealer is part of the Ten Rings team that Wenwu sends to Xialing's club in Macau to take her pendant.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Ying Nan faces Death Dealer in single combat during the Ten Rings' attack on Ta Lo and holds her own.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Deke Shaw first meets Yo-Yo in the future Lighthouse, where he yells at her and Mack for killing Kree guards and putting everyone at risk. Over time they become friends.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Enoch powers the time machine Deke uses to send the team home from the future, which accidentally pulls Deke along too.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Deke helps carry Glenn Talbot to safety when Ruby Hale attacks, and Talbot stays close while Deke's gunshot wound is treated. When Talbot uses the Gravitonium to save everyone from the Remorath, Deke is the one who thinks it is not so bad.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: General Hale tracks Deke after Daisy breaks him out of jail, suspecting he is a Life Model Decoy. Later she opens fire on the team and shoots Deke in the chest, nearly killing him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Jemma Simmons is Deke Shaw's grandmother. She treats him like family even before she knows they are related.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: In 1983, a younger John Garrett working with Nathaniel Malick captures Deke and tortures him for Fitz's whereabouts, even in front of his grandmother Jemma. Deke refuses to give him anything.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Deke Shaw grows up under Kasius' rule on the Lighthouse and at first tries to sell the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents out to him. He comes to regret it and helps them overthrow Kasius.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Leo Fitz is Deke Shaw's grandfather. Deke learns this after coming back from the future, which makes Fitz and Jemma Simmons his grandparents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Deke Shaw first meets May in the future Lighthouse, where he ambushes and pins her. They become trusted teammates.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Deke Shaw meets Phil Coulson's team in the future Lighthouse and comes to realize they are the people from the past said to save humanity. He fights beside Coulson there, rescuing Inhumans from the Kree Watch, and is accidentally pulled back to the present with them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: After General Hale shoots Deke in the chest, Piper takes the lead on his emergency surgery at the Lighthouse with Mack's help. Dazed by the drugs, Deke rambles about wanting to kiss her while admitting she does not like him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: In the future, Deke Shaw sells out Daisy Johnson and her team to Kasius and his enforcer Sinara. He later changes sides and attacks Sinara to save Daisy.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Sam calls in a favor from Dennis Dunphy, and Joaquin works with Dunphy's team at the Navy SEAL facility in Norfolk on the intel from Camp Echo One.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Dennis Dunphy is a Navy SEAL commander and a friend of Sam Wilson. When Sam needs help, he calls in a favor and has Dunphy get the gamma pills from Camp Echo One analyzed.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: When Dennis Dunphy discovers that the pills from Camp Echo One are laced with gamma radiation, Samuel Sterns tracks him down before he can warn Sam Wilson. Sterns paralyzes him with a sonic device and kills him by stopping his heart.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Dennis Dunphy tracks down Sidewinder for Sam after the Serpent Society's attacks.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Derek Bishop is Eleanor Bishop's husband until his death in the Battle of New York.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Kate is the daughter of Derek Bishop, who dies in the Battle of New York when she is a child.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Derek Bishop owed money to Wilson Fisk when he died, and Fisk later uses that debt to control his widow Eleanor.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Diamondback supplies the Hammer weapons that Cottonmouth sells to Domingo Colon. When the business sours, Diamondback tells Colon he can buy or die, and Colon is killed after his attempt on Diamondback's life fails.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: James Lucas is Willis Stryker's father, which makes Diamondback Luke Cage's half-brother.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Diamondback, born Willis Stryker, is Luke Cage's half-brother. He blames Luke for his hard life, framed him to send him to prison, and comes to Harlem to kill him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mariah Dillard works with Diamondback after Cottonmouth's death, then turns against him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Diamondback grabs Misty when she tries to ambush him, takes her gun and holds it to her head while he shoots Luke. Outside, he mocks her and demands that she beg for her life, which she refuses to do.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Diamondback recruits Shades after prison and sends him to Harlem to keep watch over Cottonmouth's operation. Shades stays at his side when Diamondback comes to kill Luke Cage, but his doubts grow and he turns to Mariah Dillard.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett helps Diamondback sell his stolen Hammer Industries guns.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Zip goes to work for Diamondback after Cottonmouth's death. When Diamondback is about to shoot Shades in a rage, Zip talks him down by pointing out it won't find Luke Cage any faster, and Diamondback laughs that Zip is smarter than his name.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Dimitri works with Mysterio while Fury's team believes he is a real hero fighting the Elementals.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Dimitri Smerdyakov is one of Nick Fury's agents and works on his team in Europe.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Fury has Dimitri drive Peter Parker's class bus around Europe to keep Peter close for the mission. Dimitri secretly sends Peter to the Seamstress to get his new stealth suit.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Soren, disguised as Maria Hill, works alongside Dimitri on Fury's team in Europe.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Talos, disguised as Nick Fury, gives Dimitri his orders during the Elementals crisis in Europe.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Dinah Madani is a Homeland Security agent who hunts Frank at first. Later she works with him against Billy Russo and Rawlins.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Karen Page and Homeland Security agent Dinah Madani both get drawn into Frank Castle's war, and they work toward the same truth.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Krista Dumont first helps Dinah Madani, then turns on her to protect Billy Russo. They try to kill each other.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Marion James, a CIA official and old friend of Hernandez, is brought in to be interviewed by Madani about the Kandahar killings. After Rawlins is killed, James questions Madani about letting Frank walk free.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Rafael Hernandez is Dinah Madani's boss at Homeland Security and her mentor.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Sam Stein is Dinah's partner and friend at Homeland Security. Billy Russo kills him.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: William Rawlins is the CIA official whom Dinah is determined to expose.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Dogpool takes a liking to Logan in the Void and fights alongside him and Deadpool.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Domingo Colon is a gang leader whom Luke fights during his war with Cottonmouth.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Domingo Colon, Cottonmouth's old rival, makes a deal with Mariah Dillard after Cottonmouth's death. He dies soon after, killed in his own attempt on Diamondback's life.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Ian Quinn agrees to buy the weather machine that Donnie Gill and Seth Dormer build at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy. The deal falls apart when Coulson's team uncovers it.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Donnie Gill, a gifted Academy cadet, idolizes Fitz, and Fitz sees a lonely kid like himself and tries to help him. Fitz saves Donnie when he is caught in his own freezing machine.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: HYDRA brainwashes Donnie, and he becomes the villain Blizzard.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: May flies into the eye of a freezing storm to rescue Donnie Gill and Seth Dormer, the cadets who caused it.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: After HYDRA brainwashes Donnie, May joins the hunt for him in Morocco.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson's team takes in Donnie Gill after a storm machine accident gives him the power to freeze things.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: When HYDRA turns Donnie into a weapon, Coulson tries to bring him in as a S.H.I.E.L.D. asset, but Donnie is killed in Casablanca.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi trains Donnie Gill in HYDRA's brainwashing program. When Donnie breaks free and hides in Morocco, Bakshi sends a team with Jemma Simmons to bring him back and triggers his conditioning again.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Kaecilius serves Dormammu and plans to bring the Dark Dimension to Earth.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Stephen Strange traps Dormammu in a time loop until Dormammu agrees to leave Earth alone.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: The Ancient One draws power from Dormammu's dimension while keeping him out of Earth.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gregory Sallinger breaks into Dorothy Walker's apartment while Jessica and Trish are hunting him, then tortures and kills her to strike back at Trish.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica is Dorothy's adoptive daughter. Dorothy takes in the orphaned Jessica as a teenager, and their relationship stays cold and bitter for years.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Trish is Dorothy Walker's daughter. Dorothy pushed her into child stardom and abused her.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Trish and Dorothy only partly make peace before Gregory Sallinger kills Dorothy to strike at Trish.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dottie Underwood is a Leviathan assassin who seduces Howard Stark under a false name, and Edwin Jarvis hands her Howard's goodbye gift.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Peggy Carter forces Dottie to work with Jarvis against Whitney Frost, and once the mission falls apart she breaks out of the trunk of his car and escapes.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dottie Underwood seduces Howard Stark under a false name while working for Leviathan. Later she kidnaps him for Fennhoff, who hypnotizes Howard into flying a plane loaded with Midnight Oil toward New York.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jack Thompson catches Dottie Underwood about to kill Peggy Carter at the Griffith Hotel, but she slips away.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Thompson helps trap Dottie during a bank robbery and interrogates her.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Dottie Underwood flirts with Jason Wilkes when Peggy Carter recruits her to steal a blood sample from Whitney Frost. Under Frost's torture Dottie gives Wilkes up, and Frost uses the distraction to kidnap him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Johann Fennhoff and Dottie Underwood are Leviathan agents who work together to strike at Howard Stark and the SSR.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dottie Underwood moves into the Griffith Hotel and befriends Peggy Carter while secretly spying on her for Leviathan. Once her cover is gone, they fight more than once.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Dottie keeps clashing with Peggy, until Peggy has to recruit her for a mission against Whitney Frost.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dottie Underwood tails SSR agent Ray Krzeminski while he is transporting a witness and kills him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vernon Masters takes Dottie Underwood out of SSR custody and tortures her, boasting of the methods he once used on a Nazi prisoner. Dottie tells him she once burned her own flesh with a blowtorch and that he is wasting his time.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Dottie Underwood is sent to target Whitney Frost. Frost later captures and tortures her.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Heinz Kruger assassinates Dr. Abraham Erskine just after Steve Rogers's transformation.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dr. Abraham Erskine and Howard Stark run the Project Rebirth procedure together. Erskine injects Steve Rogers with his serum while Howard powers up the Vita-Ray machine that completes the transformation.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Peggy Carter works with Dr. Abraham Erskine on Project Rebirth, training the recruits he is choosing from. She backs his choice of Steve Rogers and is there when a HYDRA assassin shoots Erskine moments after the procedure.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dr. Abraham Erskine tested an early version of the super-soldier serum on Johann Schmidt, which turned him into the Red Skull. Schmidt later sends an assassin to kill him.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dr. Abraham Erskine chooses Steve Rogers for the super soldier program because of his good heart. He is shot dead moments after Steve's transformation.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dr. Christina Raynor served alongside John Walker in the Army. They meet again when Walker shows up to get Bucky released from her court-ordered therapy.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dr. Raynor meets Sam Wilson at a Baltimore police station and makes him and Bucky sit through a joint therapy session.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron uses the Mind Stone to control Dr. Helen Cho and forces her to build his new body. Then he tries to kill her.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Under Ultron's mind control, Helen Cho builds the vibranium body in her Regeneration Cradle that later becomes Vision.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda and Pietro come to Helen Cho's lab with Ultron, who uses the Scepter to force Cho to build his new body. When Wanda reads Ultron's mind and sees his plan to wipe out humanity, she breaks his hold on Cho so she can stop the upload.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Dr. List captures Lincoln Campbell and Deathlok and subjects them to brutal Hydra experiments. Lincoln nearly dies under List's torture before Coulson's team rescues him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Dr. List takes Deathlok prisoner and experiments on him alongside Lincoln Campbell. After his rescue, Mike makes hunting List down his mission for Coulson.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Phil Coulson spends months hunting Dr. List, the HYDRA scientist experimenting on enhanced people. He passes the location of List's base in Sokovia to the Avengers.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Dr. List recruits Pietro and Wanda from a Sokovian protest and exposes them to the Scepter in Hydra's experiments, which give the twins their powers. When the Avengers attack, List urges Strucker to send the twins against them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: After Whitehall's death, Dr. List and Sunil Bakshi meet to sort out who will lead HYDRA. When Bakshi says he misses Whitehall, List answers that the world moves on and they must form new allegiances.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Tony Stark raids Baron Strucker's HYDRA base in Sokovia, where Dr. List runs the experiments on Loki's scepter. Iron Man blasts List as he tries to destroy the lab's research.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Dr. List recruits Wanda and Pietro from a Sokovian protest and exposes them to the Scepter in Hydra's experiments, which kill the other volunteers but give the twins their powers. When the Avengers attack, List urges Strucker to send the twins against them.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Drax travels with Quill to Ego's planet, where Mantis warns him of Ego's true plan to remake the universe. Drax then fights alongside the Guardians to destroy Ego.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax first tries to kill Gamora in the Kyln to avenge his family, since she served Ronan. Once he learns she has turned on Ronan and Thanos, they become teammates and friends in the Guardians.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Groot break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. When the regrown Groot dances behind Drax's back, he freezes every time Drax looks his way.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Drax and Mantis break into Kevin Bacon's home and kidnap him as a Christmas present for Peter Quill. After a rough start, Bacon agrees to spend Christmas with the Guardians on Knowhere.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: On the Dark Aster, Korath overpowers Peter Quill until Drax pins him to a wall and kills him by ripping out his cranial implant.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis bonds with Drax on Ego's planet and reveals Ego's true plan to him. The two become best friends.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Master Karja tries to kill Drax during the Guardians' raid on the High Evolutionary's ship.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nebula fights Drax and his allies on Knowhere on Ronan's orders.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Nebula and Drax are both Guardians now, and after the High Evolutionary is defeated they leave the team together to raise the rescued children on Knowhere.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Quill first meet as inmates in the Kyln and become founding Guardians. Drax looks out for Quill like a brother.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Drax helps rescue Phyla and the other children, and she uses her powers to help him protect them. They become friends.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Drax break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. They trade insults constantly but fight side by side.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: After years together, Drax leaves the team in Rocket's hands.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Ronan murders Drax's wife Ovette and daughter Kamaria, and Drax devotes himself to revenge. He lures Ronan to Knowhere and loses badly, then fights through the Dark Aster to help the Guardians destroy him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Drax ambushes Stephen Strange, Tony and Peter Parker on Titan before they realize they share an enemy. Drax and Strange then take on Thanos together in close combat.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Thanos sent Ronan to kill Drax's wife and daughter, and once Ronan is dead, Drax vows to kill Thanos next.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Drax finally faces Thanos on Knowhere and on Titan, but he is wiped out by the Snap.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Drax charges the Abilisk, finds its skin too tough to cut, and jumps down its throat to fight it from the inside.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary captures Drax, Nebula and Mantis and orders them fed to his Abilisks. After the Guardians defeat him, Drax carries him out of his collapsing ship so he can be imprisoned on Knowhere.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax helps Rocket threaten Yondu's ship into freeing Quill and Gamora, and the Guardians then team up with Yondu's Ravagers against Ronan.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Drax and Yondu fight together against Ego, and Yondu dies saving Quill.

stages.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
stages.text: Dre runs Donut, the coffee shop in Frank's neighborhood. Frank later saves him.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Melina works for Dreykov as the Red Room's lead scientist, designing the mind control he uses to enslave his Widows. When her daughters return, she turns on him and helps bring the Red Room down.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Dreykov raises Natasha as an assassin in the Red Room. She defects by trying to kill him in Budapest, and years later she returns to free the Widows and destroy the Red Room.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Dreykov is Antonia Dreykov's father. He turns her into Taskmaster and controls her.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Dreykov controls the Black Widows with a chemical that takes over their minds.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: In 1998, Varra spies on Dreykov for Nick Fury and brings him intelligence on Dreykov's men.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Dreykov takes Yelena into the Red Room as a child and keeps her under chemical mind control as one of his Widows. Once she is freed, she turns on him and kills him as the Red Room falls.
